response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced full-stack/systems engineer with a broad language background, but he lacks the core requirements for this role: no substantial C++ development experience on Windows, no SQL Server/Oracle depth, and no fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain exposure (his brief C/C++ work at National Instruments was over a decade ago and unrelated to finance).
strengths: 15+ years of diverse, high-quality software engineering experience
Strong systems/low-latency background (DLang, async I/O, high-performance databases)
Excellent communication skills evidenced by talks, workshops, and open-source leadership
concerns: No current or recent C++ experience, and none on Windows platform
No fixed income, derivatives, or capital markets domain experience
No evidence of SQL Server or Oracle expertise; only generic 'SQL' listed

key_factors.factor: Lack of financial services/fixed income domain experience
Strong general software engineering and communication skills
